title.zh: 前提的地图：哪些前提推出哪些，其余八个相对于彼此独立；一个世界满足全部，另一个世界中八个都起约束，满足它们的有限世界归于静止
title.en: The map of premises: which premises follow from which, the remaining eight independent relative to one another; one world meets them all, in another each of the eight binds, and a finite world meeting them comes to rest

claim.zh: 普查（Counted：每步活跃的关系项被不重复地列出，所以每步只有有限多个活跃）与有界传递（Transmitting：世系在一个界内传递每个依存）也是世界的前提。蕴含：活动需要支持推出有储备承载（零储备，Dependent.carried）；每个关系项体现推出生起者体现（Embodied.arising）；活动可判定的有限世界有普查（Finite.counted）；只有活跃者取用且只取用所汲取的、并且流耗散时，在被围住的步上只有活跃者给予，因为那里给予需要取用（acting_across），所以每步都被围住时只有活跃者给予（acting_of_enclosed），有限世界的每一步都被围住（Finite.enclosed、Finite.acting）。其余八个前提——活动需要支持、平衡、只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用且只取用所汲取的、耗散、体现、普查、有界传递（premises）——彼此独立：对每一个，都有一个世界满足其余七个而不满足它（independent）：自身水平不足以支持其活动的关系项（strained）、Shuttle 的两侧没有流（unbalanced）、一个从不活跃的关系项给予无限多个关系项而一个活跃者取回同样多（scatter）、吃者取用它并不汲取的食物（morsel）、汲取者取走储存的一个单位再还回（lossless）、立着而从不活跃的关系项（latent）、无限多个同时活跃的关系项（multitude）、亲代烧燃料给子代以水平而子代开始依存于亲代、亲代自身从未有这一依存（novel）。所以没有一个前提由其余推出（none_follows）。平衡另有一个见证，取用与耗散在其中每步起约束：持有者每步取用自身一个单位而不给予，两侧的家族每步封闭且被取用（draining_but）。不满足普查与不满足只有活跃者给予的两个世界都是无限的，与上面的蕴含一致。始终活跃的互利者满足全部八个（mutualism_premised）；有限且满足八个的世界中，生起与止息都不再复现，不用判定程序，证明用到其中的平衡、耗散与体现（premised_rests）。前提在有东西满足其条件时起约束（Premise.Binds；每个前提都起约束为 Binds），即条件有实例，不必排除表示所允许的任何东西：活动需要支持在活跃者以正需要依存于某条件时，平衡在水平变化时，只有活跃者给予与取用在参与者给予与取用时，耗散在参与者从封闭的家族取用时，体现在关系项生起时，普查在世界不有限时（这只说普查不由世界有限推出），有界传递在后代于其开始而立之步依存于某条件时。在 hatch 中八个都成立且每个都起约束（hatch_binds）：亲代取用两个单位的食物与自身的一个单位，给子代一个单位；子代开始作为条件而在，像亲代一样依存于食物，亲代止息。世界不有限，但曾经活跃的只有食物、亲代与子代（hatch_ever），无限多个地关系项闲置：从不立着、不活跃、不参与流、不被取用或给予、不被依存或汲取（hatch_idle）；曾经活跃者在一个列表上时有普查（counted_of_ever）。所以普查起约束只在于世界不有限：在静止定理之下归于静止的每个世界中，曾经活跃或立着的都不是无界多（continued-change-needs-openness 的 World.rest_few）。没有有限世界使每个前提都起约束（World.Finite.not_binds）；去掉闲置的地关系项，hatch 成为满足八个前提的有限世界（World.finiteHatch），其中除普查外每个前提都起约束（World.finiteHatch_binds_but_census）。活动需要支持起约束而不紧：食物从不低于所需；关于流的四个前提只在第一步起约束。它在第一步之后归于静止（World.hatch_rests）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: A census (Counted: the relata active at each step are listed, each once, so finitely many are active at each step) and bounded transmission (Transmitting: descent transmits every dependence within one bound) are premises of worlds too. What follows: activity needing support makes activity carried, by the zero reserve (Dependent.carried); every relatum embodied makes whatever arises embodied (Embodied.arising); a finite world whose activity is decided has a census (Finite.counted); and where only active relata take, and only from what they draw on, and the flow dissipates, only active relata give across an enclosed step, since giving needs uptake there (acting_across), so where every step is enclosed only active relata give (acting_of_enclosed), every step of a finite world being enclosed (Finite.enclosed, Finite.acting). The remaining eight premises, activity needing support, balance, only active relata giving, only active relata taking and only from what they draw on, dissipation, embodiment, a census and bounded transmission (premises), are independent: for each, a world meets the other seven and not it (independent). The worlds are a relatum whose standing does not support its activity (strained), the sides of Shuttle with no flow (unbalanced), a relatum never active giving to infinitely many while an active one takes as much back (scatter), an eater taking a morsel it does not draw on (morsel), a drawer taking its store's unit and giving it back (lossless), a relatum standing and never active (latent), infinitely many relata active at once (multitude), and a parent burning fuel to give a child its standing while the child comes to depend on the parent, a dependence the parent never had (novel). So no premise follows from the others (none_follows). For balance there is a second witness in which taking and dissipation bind at every step: the holder takes its own unit and gives nothing, and the family of both sides is closed and taken from at every step (draining_but). The worlds failing a census and failing only active relata giving are infinite, as the implications require. Mutualists active throughout meet all eight (mutualism_premised), and in a finite world which meets the eight, neither arising nor ceasing recurs, with no decision procedure, the proof using balance, dissipation and embodiment among them (premised_rests). A premise binds where something meets its condition (Premise.Binds; every premise binding is Binds), an instance, which need not exclude anything the representation allows: activity needing support where an active relatum depends on a condition at a positive need, balance where a level changes, only active relata giving and taking where something taking part gives and takes, dissipation where something taking part takes from a closed family, embodiment where a relatum arises, a census where the world is not finite (which says only that the census does not follow from the world being finite), and bounded transmission where a descendant depends on a condition at its first standing step. In hatch all eight hold and each binds (hatch_binds): a parent takes two units of food and its own unit and gives its young one unit; the young comes to stand depending on the food as the parent did, and the parent ceases. The world is not finite, though only the food, the parent and the child are ever active (hatch_ever); its infinitely many ground relata are idle, never standing, active, taking part, taken from, given to, depended on or drawn on (hatch_idle); where the relata ever active lie on one list there is a census (counted_of_ever). So a census binds only in that the world is not finite: in every world that comes to rest under the rest theorem, not unboundedly many relata are ever active or stand (World.rest_few of continued-change-needs-openness). No finite world binds every premise (World.Finite.not_binds); without its idle ground, hatch becomes a finite world meeting the eight (World.finiteHatch) in which every premise but the census binds (World.finiteHatch_binds_but_census). Activity needing support binds without being tight, the food never falling below the need, and the four premises about the flow bind at the first step only. It comes to rest after the first step (World.hatch_rests). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 蕴含：Finite.counted 要求每步每个关系项是否活跃可判定（premised_rests 不要求，P58）（核心是构造性的；经典地总是如此）；acting_of_enclosed 要求每一步都被围住。
hypotheses.en: What follows: Finite.counted needs whether each relatum is active at each step to be decidable (premised_rests does not, P58) (the core is constructive; classically it always is); acting_of_enclosed needs every step to be enclosed.

hypotheses.zh: 独立与全部满足是关于具体世界的陈述，不加前提。
hypotheses.en: Independence and meeting all of them are statements about particular worlds, with no premise.

correspondence.zh: 计划对“完整”的第三条读法要求每个动力学前提划出整个空间的真部分。P22 对七个前提给出了这一点；本结果补上普查与有界传递，并更进一步：前提不仅各自偶然，而且其余八个相对于彼此独立，在这八个之中没有一个藏在其余之中。八个是 P22 的七个去掉储备承载（由活动需要支持推出），加上普查与有界传递；连同储备承载与生起者体现这两个较弱的形式，世界层面共陈述十个前提。作者的读法（AI 论证）：蕴含显示哪些前提只是另一前提的较弱形式（有储备承载、生起者体现）或在活动可判定的有限世界中自动成立（普查；不给可判定性而对每个有限世界要求它，就蕴含排中律），以及耗散与只有活跃者取用怎样在被围住的步上带来只有活跃者给予；独立性显示剩下的每一个都是对世界的独立限定。有限与被围住不在这八个之中，而静止定理正是以它们为转折（可判定性不再需要，P58）；加上它们，只有活跃者给予与普查就推出。多个见证没有流，关于流的四个前提（只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用、耗散、有界传递）在其中空成立：strained、unbalanced、latent、multitude 与互利者没有流，scatter 没有被围住的步，morsel 没有依存、给予与世系，lossless 的水平不变；只有 novel 中其余七个都起约束。这足以证明独立；平衡另有取用与耗散每步起约束的见证（draining_but）。相对于另一读法陈述的前提——延续关系（Identity）、更新关系（Generation）、衰减的储备（Reserve）、条件家族（Flow、Dissipation）——没有在这里映射；流中每个参与者只列一次是表示的条件，不是世界的条件。前提的名称与这些世界的名称是 AI 的表述，由 Ren 定。
correspondence.en: The plan's third part of completeness asks that each dynamical premise carve a proper part of the whole space. P22 gave this for seven premises; this result adds the census and bounded transmission and goes further: the premises are not only each contingent, the remaining eight are independent relative to one another, none hidden in the others among these eight. The eight are P22's seven without the reserve carrying activity, which follows from activity needing support, together with the census and bounded transmission; with the two weaker forms, a reserve carrying activity and embodied arising, ten premises are stated of worlds. The author's reading (an AI argument): the implications show which premises are only weaker forms of another (activity carried, whatever arises embodied) or hold automatically in finite worlds whose activity is decided (a census; asking it of every finite world without decidability implies excluded middle), and how dissipation and only active relata taking bring only active relata giving across enclosed steps; independence shows that each of the rest is a separate restriction of worlds. Finiteness and enclosure are not among the eight, though the rest theorems turn on them (decidability is no longer needed, P58); with them added, only active relata giving and a census follow. Several witnesses have no flow, so the four premises about the flow (only active relata giving, only active relata taking, dissipation, bounded transmission) hold vacuously there: strained, unbalanced, latent, multitude and the mutualists have no flow, scatter has no enclosed step, morsel has no dependence, giving or descent, and the levels of lossless are steady; only in novel do all the other seven bind. That suffices for independence; for balance a second witness has taking and dissipation binding at every step (draining_but). Premises stated relative to a further reading, a continuation relation (Identity), a renewal relation (Generation), a decaying reserve (Reserve) or a family of conditions (Flow, Dissipation), are not mapped here; that each formation taking part is listed once in a flow is a condition of the representation, not of the world. The names of the premises and of these worlds are the AI's formulations, and Ren's to choose.

detail.zh: 复用世界、其部分与前提（World）、静止（rests）、unbalanced 与 mutualism 两个世界。
detail.en: Reuses worlds, their parts and premises (World), rest (rests), and the worlds unbalanced and mutualism.

output.zh: 世界上的七个前提各有满足与不满足它的世界；有限、平衡、耗散且生起者体现的世界归于静止。
output.en: Seven premises on worlds, each met and failed by some world; a finite, balanced, dissipative world whose arising is embodied comes to rest.

input.zh: 八个前提的地图：蕴含、独立与全部满足；有限世界中全部前提一起归于静止。
input.en: The map of eight premises: implications, independence and one world meeting all; in a finite world all together come to rest.

detail.zh: 复用耗散（Dissipative）、被围住的步（Enclosed）与给予需要取用（giving_needs_uptake）。
detail.en: Reuses dissipation (Dissipative), enclosed steps (Enclosed) and giving needing uptake (giving_needs_uptake).

output.zh: 耗散之下，被围住的步上给予的形成从某个条件取用。
output.en: Under dissipation, across an enclosed step a formation that gives takes from some condition.

input.zh: 只有活跃者取用且耗散时，每个被围住的步上只有活跃者给予。
input.en: Where only active relata take and the flow dissipates, only active relata give across every enclosed step.

conditions.zh: 每一步都被围住；有限世界中自动成立。
conditions.en: Every step enclosed; automatic in a finite world.

detail.zh: 复用普查（Census）与不重复的列表（Distinct）。
detail.en: Reuses the census (Census) and lists without repetition (Distinct).

output.zh: 普查不重复地列出每步活跃的形成。
output.en: A census lists the formations active at each step, each once.

input.zh: 世界上的普查前提；活动可判定的有限世界有普查。
input.en: The census as a premise of worlds; a finite world whose activity is decided has one.

output.zh: 在一个界内传递对某个条件的依存。
output.en: Transmission of a dependence on a condition within a bound.

input.zh: 世界上的有界传递前提；它的反例 novel。
input.en: Bounded transmission as a premise of worlds; its countermodel novel.

detail.en: Reuses that Dependent is exactly the zero reserve (carries_zero).

output.zh: 零储备承载活动当且仅当活动需要支持。
output.en: The zero reserve carries activity exactly when activity needs support.

input.zh: 活动需要支持推出有储备承载。
input.en: Activity needing support makes activity carried.

output.zh: 互利者都体现，活动需要支持。
output.en: The mutualists are embodied, and their activity needs support.

input.zh: 满足全部八个前提的世界。
input.en: A world meeting all eight premises.

detail.zh: 完成计划 P24：前提的地图补上完整性的第三条读法；这不是无公理的整体演绎。
detail.en: Completes plan P24: the map of premises completes the third part of completeness; this is not the deduction of the whole without axioms.

detail.zh: 有限世界中全部前提一起归于静止，是那里 generation_ceases 读于满足全部前提的世界。
detail.en: That all premises together bring a finite world to rest is generation_ceases read of worlds meeting every premise.

detail.zh: 八个独立性见证：strained、unbalanced、scatter、morsel、lossless、latent、multitude、novel，各不满足一个前提而满足其余七个。
detail.en: Eight independence witnesses, strained, unbalanced, scatter, morsel, lossless, latent, multitude and novel, each failing one premise and meeting the other seven.

detail.zh: draining：平衡之外的每个前提都满足，两侧的家族每步封闭且被取用，所以取用与耗散不空成立。
detail.en: draining: every premise but balance is met, and the family of both sides is closed and taken from at every step, so taking and dissipation do not hold vacuously.

limitations.zh: 只映射世界层面的八个前提；相对于延续关系、更新关系、衰减的储备或条件家族的前提未映射；独立性是相对于这八个前提的，不排除另加前提时出现新的蕴含；有限世界的蕴含要求活动可判定；只对离散步的读法陈述；起约束只说某个条件被满足，普查的起约束只说世界不有限，不说前提在该世界中独立于其余前提；不评价任何部分；前提与世界的名称由 Ren 定。
limitations.en: Maps only the eight premises stated of worlds; premises relative to a continuation relation, a renewal relation, a decaying reserve or a family of conditions are not mapped; independence is relative to these eight and does not exclude new implications once further premises are added; the implications for finite worlds need decidable activity; stated for the reading across discrete steps; binding says only that some condition is met, and for a census only that the world is not finite, not that the premise is independent of the others in that world; evaluates no part; the names of premises and worlds are Ren's to choose.

next_delta.zh: 对每个世界的确切重述是本记录的 Web.carries_zero_across（P63），局部条件写在规律之内：在一步、一个形成上；Web.carries_zero是它的推论；对每个世界的确切重述是本记录的 World.acting_across_on、keep_lists（P60），局部条件写在规律之内：只在该步：一个闭合且被耗散的家族与该步的取用者活跃；列出只用该步覆盖活跃者的列表；World.acting_across（以及经它的 acting_of_enclosed、Finite.acting）、World.Finite.counted是它们的推论；相对于另一读法的前提（延续关系、更新关系、衰减的储备、条件家族）的地图；名称（Ren）。在普查与被围住之下的静止已由 P25 与 P26 回答（continued-change-needs-openness）；满足全部八个且每个都起约束的世界由 P29 给出（hatch_binds，P29 时名为 brood_binds）；普查起约束只在于世界不有限（P29b）。
next_delta.en: The exact restatement for every world is this record's Web.carries_zero_across (P63), the local condition inside the law: at one step and formation; Web.carries_zero is its corollary; the exact restatement for every world is this record's World.acting_across_on, keep_lists (P60), the local condition inside the law: that step only: one family closed and dissipated on, and the takers there active; the listing uses only a list covering the active relata at that step; World.acting_across (and through it acting_of_enclosed, Finite.acting), World.Finite.counted are their corollaries; a map of the premises stated relative to a further reading (a continuation relation, a renewal relation, a decaying reserve, a family of conditions); names (Ren). Rest under censuses and enclosure is answered by P25 and P26 (continued-change-needs-openness); a world meeting all eight with each binding is given by P29 (hatch_binds, named brood_binds in P29); a census binds only in that the world is not finite (P29b).
